rationale: The purpose is assay-independent artifact exclusion, not improving Route-A/Route-B agreement.
Boyle Lab describes ENCODE blacklist removal as an essential quality measure for functional-genomics sequencing analyses.
The choice is frozen before Route-B consensus peaks or Route-A/Route-B network agreement are observed.
execution_gate: download from the immutable release commit, not master
compute SHA-256 locally and bind it into the Route-B receipt
decompress and require exactly 636 BED records before peak construction
fail closed if chromosome naming is incompatible with the Route-B chromsizes
pass the pinned local BED path explicitly to path_to_blacklist
record regions removed by blacklist overlap without using that count to retune any threshold
forbidden: choose a different blacklist after seeing Route-A/Route-B agreement
silently omit the blacklist because it reduces agreement
substitute a different ENCODE portal blacklist without a new versioned amendment
treat blacklist-overlapping regions as biological zero
